feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 September 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 09 September 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea continuing to fill as a ridge of high pressure to the west of Ireland approaches the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, backing west or northwest 2 to 4 in the afternoon, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, quickly backing south 5 to 7, veering southwest 3 or 4 in the evening, veering west 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, quickly building mainly moderate and occasionally rough in the west. Becoming mainly slight later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle quickly arriving, then clearing in the evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
